routeHint: Settings -> Customization -> Import, scrolled to the history at the foot of the page. The heading sits in its own div.import-section-heading and the table is a SIBLING (.orgo-table-wrap.import-history__table), so the old xpath of the heading's parent cropped to the heading strip alone and produced a 5kb sliver. Crop to the table.
alt: Import History table listing past imports by type and status, including a processing import, a failed import and a completed import whose results count shows three failed rows, with a Rollback button on the completed imports
notes: Do NOT expand any row. The seeded demo imports have no import_log rows behind them, and on other tenants the detail panel prints raw imported data.

routeHint: Settings (gear) -> Developers -> Merge Records. MergeIndex.created() reads tenant.settingFeatures.users.hasMergeProfiles before the tenant is in the store on a hard page load and bounces to the dashboard, so land on another settings page and click Merge Records in the settings sidebar. Contact Duplicates is empty on this tenant; User Duplicates has ~25 pairs at 70% Same name.
alt: Merge Records page with the manual source and target selectors above a Duplicate Suggestions table showing match scores and reasons

routeHint: Same navigation as merge-records, then Merge on the first suggested pair to load the comparison step. Do NOT press Execute Merge. text=Merge alone matches the Merge Records heading first, hence the class selector for the row button. Tall viewport so the conflict rows and Related Records to Transfer both fit.
alt: Merge comparison table with source and target columns, Conflict tags and radio buttons for choosing which value to keep, above the related record counts
notes: Custom field 454 'Professional Registration Number' held motivation-for-joining sentences on all 59 rows (seeder bug), which showed up as a paragraph of prose in a registration-number cell on the comparison grid. Replaced with PRN-<year>-<serial> values on 2026-08-05.

routeHint: Settings (gear) -> Developers -> Merge Records -> Merge History. Same hard-load bounce as merge-records, so navigate through the settings sidebar. Tenant 282 had no completed merges and the page shipped as an empty state; three merge_log rows were seeded on 2026-08-05 instead of executing a real merge, which would have tombstoned a demo member. The endpoint (MergeController::logs) reads only merge_log columns, so the rows render fully without any record being touched.
alt: Merge History table listing past merges with date, type, source and target records, who performed them and their status, with an Undo button while the rollback window is open and Expired once it has closed
notes: The three rows deliberately cover all three states the column renders: a Contact to User merge still inside its 30-day rollback window (Undo button), an older User to User merge past it (Expired), and a rolled back Contact to Contact merge.

routeHint: Settings (gear) -> Import, address /tenants/import. The route needs WORKSPACE_ADMIN, which is the Orgo administrator flag rather than the admin permission. Added 2026-11-11: this image was on the import page but no spec wrote it, so it could never be refreshed and had drifted from the screen. Checked against the image on 2026-11-11: the screen is headed 'Data import' with a count badge, and each row carries a Column mapping badge, an Example CSV link and a Choose file button. The older capture of this same screen, headed 'Data Import System' with Choose CSV buttons, is what import-steps-list wrote; that spec is dropped because the two were the same screen a version apart. Also used on platform/contacts/sources.mdx: contacts go through the same wizard, so the same image serves both rather than a second file of the same screen. RECAPTURED 2026-11-11 after the code checkout was fast-forwarded to master cd9f72d67e: commit 021bab83b9 removed the Download a template button from every step card (it returned a file byte-identical to Example CSV), so the image now shows Column mapping, Example CSV and Choose file only. GET /imports/template/{type} still exists for API and support use.
alt: The Data import page listing the import steps in their recommended order, each with a Column mapping badge, an Example CSV link and a Choose file button, with one step showing a completed run and its successful row count
notes: The four mid-wizard import images are now driven by specs/import-wizard.json, which uses the capture runner's `upload` verb and the committed fixtures. Only orgo-support-conversation.png is left with no spec behind it.
